content: उपस्करः .²1 Any article which serves to make anything complete, an ingredient; यथा कीडोपस्कराणां संयोगविगमाविह . इच्छया कीडितुः स्यातां तथैवेशेच्छया नृणाम् .. <ls>Bhāg. 1. 13. 43</ls>; <ls>Rām. 2. 30. 44</ls>. .²2 (Hence) Condiment or seasoning for food (as mustard, pepper <ab>&c.</ab>) .²3 Furniture, appurtenance, apparatus, instrument (उपकरण); उपस्करो रथस्यासीत् <ls>Mb.</ls>; <ls>Śi. 18. 72</ls>. .²4 Any article or implement of household use (such as a broomstick); संयतोपस्करा दक्षा <ls>Y. 1. 83</ls>, <ls n="Y.">2. 193</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 68</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">12. 66</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 150</ls>. .²5 An ornament. .²6 Censure, blame.
